name: Theme Picker
description: Centered card that previews four color themes as selectable swatch tiles, with a sliding-icon cycle button and a footer button. The whole card recolors on selection.
contents: Card with title, description and sliding icon cycle button
Grid of theme tiles with icon, name and overlapping color chips
behavior: Selecting a tile or cycling applies that theme's tokens as CSS variables with a color transition
Active tile shows a ring and checkmark badge
Top icon column slides vertically to the active theme icon

props.name: description
props.default: Cycle through 4 distinctive interface layers, optimized from darkest to lightest configurations.

props.name: themes
props.default: dark, sunset, sunrise, light token sets

editableByProps: All theme names and their seven color tokens

needsCodeEdit.where: ICONS constant and the icon components
translateY style on the sliding track
